name: calendly
description: Read Calendly scheduled events, event types, and invitees using the user's own token. Load to see upcoming meetings and who booked them.

content.inline:
## Calendly
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` against `https://api.calendly.com` with `bearerSecret: "s/CALENDLY_TOKEN"` (a personal access token: Integrations -> API & Webhooks). Only the secret reference goes in the request; never the token.

Common calls:
- Whoami: `GET /users/me` -> `resource.uri` (your user URI) and `resource.current_organization`
- Your event types: `GET /event_types?user={user_uri}`
- Scheduled events: `GET /scheduled_events?user={user_uri}&status=active&sort=start_time:asc` (or `organization={org_uri}` for the whole org)
- One event: `GET /scheduled_events/{uuid}`
- Invitees: `GET /scheduled_events/{uuid}/invitees`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{title, message}`. 401 = bad/expired token.
- Most list calls need a `user` or `organization` URI from `GET /users/me`; fetch that first and pass the full URI, URL-encoded with `v/ops/jvm/url-encode`.
- Times are ISO 8601 UTC; window with `min_start_time` / `max_start_time`.
